newsitem.title: USA: POWER SNAG TRIMS RUNS AT VALERO'S TEXAS REFINERY.
newsitem.headline: POWER SNAG TRIMS RUNS AT VALERO'S TEXAS REFINERY.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said it cut
runs by 5-10 percent during peak operating times at its Corpus Christi, Texas refinery because of problems with the local power supply.

A 70,000 barrel per day hydrodesulphurization unit and 36,000 bpd hydrocracker should see reduced runs between 1200 and 1900 EDT (1700 to 0000 GMT) due to generating problems at Central Power and Light Co.
"We've had to cut back a little bit," said Keith Booke, company spokesman. "(Central Power and Light) expect to resolve it in a very short time," he added.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
